summary: This configures PHPUnit to use two traits for all feature tests in the Feature directory. The TestCase trait provides basic test utilities, and RefreshDatabase automatically resets the database before each test so tests don't interfere with each other.

explanations.1: The `uses()` function tells PHPUnit to apply these traits to all test files matching the `->in('Feature')` path filter, so you don't have to manually add them to each test class.
